# PhantomForge Vendor Dependencies Index

Third-party dependencies and definitions required for FromSoftware parameter decoding and binary regulation patching.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Paramdex/` | Elden Ring parameter definitions (XML defs) defining layout, offset, and type metadata for regulation params. |
| `SoulsFormatsNEXT/` | .NET library providing binary readers/writers for FromSoftware file formats (BND4, DCX, FMG, PARAM, AES decryption). |
